searchText: this sounds reasonable to me. don't see any issue with doing that This is very good for transaction latency as well. We’d like to ensure that there is as little distance between the proposer commitment and the release of the exec payload, otherwise this could negate many of the gains of shorter slot times yeah definitely, I believe we are forced anyway to keep moving the PTC deadline according to the gas limit (in principle we could specify it as a function of it). But the nice thing about Mark's idea is that it leaves the maximum broadcast for blobs all the time constant at the end of the slot why are we forced to move it according to the gas limit, assuming we always have enough time to execute by the time the propagation interval is over? (and even better if nodes can receive blobs without blocking execution) I think there's always an incentive to delay the Payload, so it's in the protocol interest to force the Payload reveal to be as early as possible and the blob DA to be as late as possible Right but moving the PTC forward in time just eats on your releasing blob DA budget no? So if you do this, then the higher the gas limit is, the lower you would set the PTC to? We will have two deadlines: Payload availability and blob availability. The latter is stably at the end of the slot. The former should be the minimum time that takes to propagate the largest block at the given gas limit starting from the attestation deadline Ah ok yes I think this is good to explore. I thought you meant using a single deadline, the PTC being an availability committee for both blobs and the exec payload So in this world with two deadlines “PTC” is really just “payload”, and then there is a “BTC” (blob timeliness committee? 😬) How early do you think the attestation deadline can be? Is 1s enough time for beacon block propagation/attestation? No the idea is that the PTC enforces both. They attest late but they only attest to the Payload being timely if it was before the earlier deadline ah yeah got it, got my wires crossed

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: this sounds reasonable to me. don't see any issue with doing that

excerpts.author: barnabemonnot
excerpts.content: This is very good for transaction latency as well. We’d like to ensure that there is as little distance between the proposer commitment and the release of the exec payload, otherwise this could negate many of the gains of shorter slot times

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: yeah definitely, I believe we are forced anyway to keep moving the PTC deadline according to the gas limit (in principle we could specify it as a function of it). But the nice thing about Mark's idea is that it leaves the maximum broadcast for blobs all the time constant at the end of the slot

excerpts.author: barnabemonnot
excerpts.content: why are we forced to move it according to the gas limit, assuming we always have enough time to execute by the time the propagation interval is over? (and even better if nodes can receive blobs without blocking execution)

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: I think there's always an incentive to delay the Payload, so it's in the protocol interest to force the Payload reveal to be as early as possible and the blob DA to be as late as possible

excerpts.author: barnabemonnot
excerpts.content: Right but moving the PTC forward in time just eats on your releasing blob DA budget no? So if you do this, then the higher the gas limit is, the lower you would set the PTC to?

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: We will have two deadlines: Payload availability and blob availability. The latter is stably at the end of the slot. The former should be the minimum time that takes to propagate the largest block at the given gas limit starting from the attestation deadline

excerpts.author: barnabemonnot
excerpts.content: Ah ok yes I think this is good to explore. I thought you meant using a single deadline, the PTC being an availability committee for both blobs and the exec payload

excerpts.author: barnabemonnot
excerpts.content: So in this world with two deadlines “PTC” is really just “payload”, and then there is a “BTC” (blob timeliness committee? 😬)

excerpts.author: barnabemonnot
excerpts.content: How early do you think the attestation deadline can be? Is 1s enough time for beacon block propagation/attestation?

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: No the idea is that the PTC enforces both. They attest late but they only attest to the Payload being timely if it was before the earlier deadline

excerpts.author: barnabemonnot
excerpts.content: ah yeah got it, got my wires crossed
